2608.23104.title: Molecular LLM Agents: From Architectural Design to Scientific Autonomy
2608.23104.paper_summary: Molecular science represents an important frontier for LLM-based agents. Unlike general agents that mainly operate over natural language, code, or web environments, molecular LLM agents must perceive, reason about, and act upon chemical objects across symbolic strings, molecular graphs, 3D conformations, spectra, simulations, and wet-lab measurements. Their capabilities depend on chemically faithful molecular perception, an LLM-centered agent framework, domain-specific tool grounding, and computational or experimental feedback, in addition to planning and tool use. This work develops a conceptual framework for molecular LLM agents from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce an architectural view of molecular-agent design, covering molecular representation and perception, the agent framework, domain-specific toolboxes, and learning and optimization. Second, we propose a scientific autonomy ladder inspired by staged autonomy in engineering systems, categorizing agents into four levels: L1 assistive or fixed workflows, L2 adaptive computational agents, L3 feedback-aware physical experiment agents, and L4 scientific-agenda agents. Together, these two perspectives establish a comprehensive framework for comparing existing molecular LLM agents, identifying missing capabilities and deployment risks, and guiding the design, evaluation, and deployment of future agents in molecular discovery workflows.
2608.23104.paper_summary_zh: 分子科學代表了基於大型語言模型（LLM）代理的重要前沿。與主要在自然語言、代碼或網絡環境中運作的一般代理不同，分子LLM代理必須在符號字符串、分子圖、三維構象、光譜、模擬和濕實驗測量中感知、推理和對化學物體採取行動。它們的能力依賴於化學上真實的分子感知、以LLM為中心的代理框架、特定領域的工具基礎以及計算或實驗反饋，此外還包括計劃和工具使用。本研究從兩個互補的角度發展了分子LLM代理的概念框架。首先，我們介紹了分子代理設計的架構視角，涵蓋了分子表示和感知、代理框架、特定領域的工具箱以及學習和優化。其次，我們提出了一個受工程系統分階段自主性啟發的科學自主性梯度，將代理分為四個級別：L1 輔助或固定工作流程、L2 自適應計算代理、L3 反饋感知的物理實驗代理，以及 L4 科學議程代理。這兩個視角共同建立了一個全面的框架，用於比較現有的分子LLM代理，識別缺失的能力和部署風險，並指導未來在分子發現工作流程中代理的設計、評估和部署。
